clue.text: One could play it but a tree is in the way

indicators.note: says the tree stands inside the letters for the way

parts.note: a way is a street, abbreviated St
a pine is a kind of tree

explanation.surface: A would-be player finds a tree blocking the path.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small keyboard instrument like a harpsichord, so a musician could perform on it.

clue.text: Talk that will p-perturb

parts.note: the stammered letter before the hyphen is taken as written
to rattle someone is to perturb or unsettle them

explanation.surface: A stammering speaker warns of words that will upset someone.
explanation.walkthrough: The stammer in 'p-perturb' is the device: put a P in front of a synonym of perturb.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym as verb or noun: idle, chattering speech.

clue.text: She writes of a ramshackle hut with rambling roses

indicators.note: something ramshackle is falling apart, so the letters of hut are rearranged
rambling means wandering about, so the letters of roses are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A woman's book describes a tumbledown cottage covered in climbing flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A female writer, described by what she does.

clue.text: Manage to solve it? Away with you?

definitions.meaning: to work a puzzle or a sum through to its answer, as in getting it to come out
an exclamation of disbelief, or an order to leave

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase both means finishing a puzzle successfully and is a brusque exclamation telling someone to leave.

clue.text: A number surrounded by buzzing horse flies

indicators.note: says the number sits inside the rearranged letters
buzzing suggests agitated movement, so the letters of horse are rearranged

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: A swarm of biting insects whirring all around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'buzzing' rearranges HORSE into HOERS and 'surrounded by' puts V inside it. 'horse flies' looks like the insects; 'flies' alone is the definition, a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym as a verb: stays aloft in one place, as a kestrel does.

clue.text: Before you strike the other out

parts.note: to strike is to hit

indicators.note: out can mean wrong or astray, so the letters of other are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is told to cross out the alternative before they hit.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym in the sense of up to this time, previously.

clue.text: Travel off, having a right to leave, with the attendant

indicators.note: off can mean spoiled or awry, so the letters are rearranged
says the letter for right departs from the fodder

parts.note: R is the standard abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone entitled to go sets off on a journey with a servant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to leave' takes R out of TRAVEL, and 'off' rearranges the remaining TAVEL.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a manservant who attends to a gentleman's clothes.

clue.text: Caught as one came home drunk

definitions.meaning: what an angler has done to a fish on the line
a drunk person staggers through the door

explanation.definitionFit: An angler landing a fish wound the line back, and a drunk arriving home staggered through the door.

clue.text: Through having smoked, is smelling of

parts.note: per is Latin for through or by means of
something that fumed gave off smoke

explanation.surface: Someone who has had a cigarette still carries the odour.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose synonym: scented, carrying a fragrance.

clue.text: Was, first to last, strange: was evasive

indicators.note: strange means odd or unfamiliar, so the letters of last are rearranged

parts.note: whoever was first in a race led it

explanation.surface: Someone behaved oddly from beginning to end and dodged every question.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first to last' looks like an instruction to move a letter; instead 'Was, first' is LED and 'strange' rearranges LAST into STAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: played for time and avoided giving an answer.

clue.text: Nick, on top, is really good

indicators.note: says that with these letters put on the front, the answer becomes the phrase for really good

parts.note: top-notch means excellent
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man called Nick, on top form, is excellent.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: 'on' says the answer with TOP put on it is a phrase meaning really good.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a small cut made in an edge.

clue.text: Agitated that it's not yet decided

definitions.meaning: still open, as a question or a bill may be

explanation.surface: Someone is upset that a matter remains open.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes both a disturbed, uneasy person and a question still left open.

clue.text: Does it prove an earner for the draper?

definitions.text: Does it prove an earner for the draper?

parts.words: Does it prove an earner for the draper?
parts.note: a draper sells fabrics, one of them an open mesh used for curtains, and its name is also a verb meaning to earn as clear profit

explanation.surface: A cloth merchant wonders whether one line of stock makes money.
explanation.definitionFit: A pun: a meshed fabric a cloth seller stocks, and a verb meaning to make as clear profit.

clue.text: Bear, or carry, with real trouble, inside

indicators.note: says the rearranged letters go within the word for carry

parts.note: to tote something is to carry it

indicators.note: to trouble something is to disturb it, so the letters of real are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone must shoulder a burden while hiding a genuine worry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bear, or carry' looks like two synonyms for one word, but only the first is the definition; the second is the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym as a verb: to put up with or endure.

clue.text: Grasp and embrace

definitions.meaning: to understand or absorb an idea

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to understand something and to include it within a scope.

clue.text: In accordance with the contract

definitions.meaning: a formal deal binding two parties

explanation.surface: Something is done just as the signed deal requires.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both harmony between parties and a formal binding deal.

clue.text: Inside out, it's OK

definitions.meaning: to know a subject inside out is to know it thoroughly

explanation.surface: A jumper worn the wrong way round is judged acceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes knowing a subject thoroughly and is also a reply giving assent.

clue.text: Turn to an addendum on water

indicators.note: to turn is to face the other way, so these letters are read backwards

parts.note: an gives the article A
PS, a postscript, is something added to a letter

explanation.surface: A reader is sent to an appendix about water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn to' reads A PS backwards as a whole.
explanation.definitionFit: A mineral spring, often simply called the waters.

clue.text: Won't hurt dad to get out more

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father
whoever gets out more is in less

explanation.surface: It would do father no harm to leave the house more often.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get out more' is a playful paraphrase: to be out more is to be IN LESS.
explanation.definitionFit: A description: causing no suffering.

clue.text: Follow round in, performing

indicators.note: says the answer goes round these two letters to make the word for performing, so they come out

parts.note: doing is performing an action
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone trails an act around the ring as it performs.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: it describes a longer word meaning performing as the answer wrapped 'round' the clue's own word 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym as a verb: to trail someone closely.

clue.text: She got a bum steer, to start with

indicators.note: says the rearranged letters come first, ahead of the article
bum means bad or faulty, so the letters of steer are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman was given bad advice at the outset.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a woman's name.

clue.text: Rocks when I change ends

indicators.note: the ends of a word are its first and last letters, here of change

explanation.surface: A boat sways as the speaker swaps sides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ends' takes the first and last letters of 'change'. 'Rocks' reads as a verb but is slang for diamonds, or the cubes in a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang synonym: frozen cubes in a drink, or diamonds.

clue.text: A fellow member brought in something to wear

indicators.note: says the member is carried inside the word for fellow

parts.note: a gent is a man or fellow
an arm is a limb, and a limb is a member of the body

explanation.surface: A man from the club arrived carrying an outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: A general description: any article of clothing.

clue.text: One's entitlement to work for the secret service

definitions.text: One's entitlement to work for the secret service

parts.words: One's entitlement to work for the secret service
parts.note: entitlement is read playfully as being given a title: the alias a spy is known by

explanation.surface: A spy's right to be employed by the intelligence agency.
explanation.definitionFit: A playful description: the alias under which an agent operates.

clue.text: Roaring out "start off with the herb!"

indicators.note: out can mean astray or wrong, so the letters are rearranged
says the first letter of Roaring is removed

parts.note: the opening letter of Roaring, the one taken away

explanation.surface: A cook bellows that the dish must begin with a seasoning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'start off' drops the first R of ROARING, and 'out' rearranges the remaining OARING.
explanation.definitionFit: An older name for wild marjoram or oregano, a culinary plant.

clue.text: Said it's two letters too many

indicators.note: says the two letters are spoken, and their names heard together make the answer

parts.note: the letters X and S, said by name one after the other

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a word has a couple of characters over.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a surplus, more than is needed.

clue.text: Egad! So that's how the horse got spooked!

definitions.meaning: an old-fashioned mild oath or exclamation of surprise

definitions.text: So that's how the horse got spooked!
definitions.meaning: a loud clap from a storm is what frightened the animal

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an old mild oath, and also says a storm's noise frightened the animal.

clue.text: Gives pointers to

definitions.meaning: passes something over to another person
the parts of a clock that point to the time

explanation.definitionFit: The word means passes something across, and also names what indicate the time on a clock.

clue.text: Do an impression of an operatic heroine: top-class

parts.note: Mimi is the heroine of Puccini's opera La Boheme

indicators.note: the top of a word is its first letter, here of class

explanation.surface: An impersonator takes off a leading soprano brilliantly.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym as a verb: to imitate someone.

clue.text: Ramble on about a repairman

indicators.note: says the word for repairman goes round the article

parts.note: a mender is someone who repairs things

explanation.surface: A bore talks at length about a tradesman.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: to wander aimlessly, in walking or in speech.

clue.text: Means to get by working

parts.note: means is read as income, the money obtained through one's job, rather than as the verb intends

explanation.surface: Someone intends to scrape through with hard graft.
explanation.definitionFit: A description: the income a job brings in.

clue.text: Finishes with many ahead of: doesn't win

indicators.note: says the numeral comes before the word for doesn't win

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword stand-in for many
whoever doesn't win loses

explanation.surface: A runner ends the race in front of plenty of others yet takes no prize.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym as a verb: brings to an end.
